description: This PHP class defines the PerformanceTrackerModel, which represents a data model for performance tracking entities within the OrangeHRM system. It acts as a serializer/model layer to expose performance tracker data through an API, including related employee information.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes PerformanceTracker entity data for API responses, including related employee details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PerformanceTracker entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
